title: Get a permit to busk or perform in public places
what: Get the council's permit before busking or performing in streets or other public places.

laws.title: Shire of Trayning Activities in Thoroughfares and Public Places and Trading Local Law 2025

confidence_note: Quotes the local law as made, from the WA Government Gazette; WA publishes no consolidated local laws. The clause was found by a pattern search of every Gazette from 1996 to 2026 (E-8), and the law was taken as in force because no later repeal naming it was found. Amended later (Gazette No. 120, 22 Sep 2026); the amendments were not read.
